stage: Before final target is delivered/read and before reviewer implementation. Frozen predecessor review exposes the expected continuum coefficients; this is not blind coefficient discovery.
independence: Same-family review of a unit authored by another worker. This reviewer authored separate covariance/background/source-sector units; did not author or inspect the upcoming coupling draft or its checker.

numerical_checks.name: determinant_phase_coefficient
numerical_checks.method: Exact rational/symbolic determinant expansion of a noncommuting finite matrix with both ordered Fourier transfers, compared with the separately derived trace-log expansion.
numerical_checks.criterion: Exact equality through degree two; replacing bubble 1/2 by1/4, omitting either transfer, or changing a determinant weight must be detected by a nonzero exact difference.

numerical_checks.name: continuum_charge_and_Flow_dictionary
numerical_checks.method: Derive sphere moments via rotational polynomial identities, compute scalar/vector orbital and spin coefficients, sum general SU(N) roots algebraically, and convert HS-normalized external direction to the actual Wilson plane-wave density.
numerical_checks.criterion: Exact symbolic arithmetic; verify conversion without hardcoding final -21/-22 or beta0 into the check being tested. Wrong bubble, spin, charge-twice, trace-colour or HS normalization must change the result.

numerical_checks.name: actual_SU2_offshell_coordinate_change
numerical_checks.method: Wilson trace of one SU(2) plaquette with nontrivial background; compare left-multiplicative and additive-log quantum Hessians, first/second chain rules, and full exponential-coordinate Jacobian.
numerical_checks.criterion: Exact Taylor equality through background degree four where the full chain rule is used; congruence-only or omitted Jacobian/force corrections must produce a nonzero degree-two or-four term.

numerical_checks.name: bounded_finite_part_is_not_increment_convergence
numerical_checks.method: Exact alternating bounded finite-part sequence and its telescoping increments.
numerical_checks.criterion: All-increment bracket holds with twice the bound, while adjacent increments need not converge. Reject an inference to b_n convergence from boundedness alone.

later_actual_target_controls: After final source/checker exposure, register any selected code mutants separately with that disclosure; do not quietly relabel them pre-exposure.
resources: No massive replay. Gate all executions on owner lock/resource contract; nice, one BLAS/OMP thread, <2GB memory, >=50% free RAM and load constraints.
scope: Numerical statements only. Analytic reconstruction and final target review remain open until the frozen target identities are supplied.
